Here we provide a merge script that bakes the LoRA adapters directly into the base weights and produces a standard checkpoint directory.

- [Run concurrent workloads](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/guides/run-concurrent-workloads.md): Bound parallel operations, correlate state, classify failures, and cancel only work owned by the batch.
- [Sandboxes cookbook](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/index.md): Complete Sandboxes workflows with explicit state, expected outcomes, and failure handling.
- [Prepare once, reuse safely](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/prepare-once-reuse-safely.md): Save one prepared filesystem image and reuse it in independent later operations.
- [Stream a build or test run](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/stream-a-build-or-test-run.md): Run a deterministic test suite, display stdout and stderr over SSE, resume after disconnect, and verify both success and failure.
- [Interact with a process during an operation](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/interact-with-a-process.md): Spawn a child in an active operation, send two inputs and EOF, test signals and parent finalization, and clean up on failure.
- [Try two coding fixes and keep the passing branch](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/try-two-coding-fixes.md): Apply two isolated patches to failing deterministic tests, select the passing image, and continue from it.
- [Generate and download a binary artifact](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/generate-and-download-binary-artifact.md): Produce a deterministic binary file, retain it, download it, and verify exact bytes locally.
- [Build and refresh a reusable custom environment](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/build-reusable-custom-environment.md): Build the supported Dockerfile subset, resolve the immutable UUID, run twice, and refresh after a source change.
- [Prepare inputs, then verify with networking disabled](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/verify-with-networking-disabled.md): Save prepared inputs, verify them without a guest network interface, and inspect both operations using Python.
- [Run a bounded evaluation batch](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/run-bounded-evaluation-batch.md): Correlate item, operation, and image IDs; classify outcomes; and cancel only work owned by the batch.
- [Recover from a known-good image](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/recover-from-known-good-image.md): Diagnose a deliberate command failure and retry corrected work from the recorded checkpoint.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/operate/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose access, execution, output, state, subprocess, network, and concurrency failures.
- [Limits, retention, and usage](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/operate/limits-retention-and-usage.md): Plan for service limits and retention, and inspect the fields available to your account.
- [Security and data handling](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/operate/security-and-data-handling.md): Protect data and credentials across uploads, output, images, networking, and local downloads.
- [Update images and clients](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/operate/update-images-and-clients.md): Refresh prepared images, pin immutable inputs, and validate client upgrades.
- [Reference map and compatibility](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/reference/index.md): Find REST endpoints, Python methods, CLI commands, and MCP tools for your workflow.
